strings.دروس تشطيب البيت في الكويت 14: راجع القط: Home finishing lessons in Kuwait 14: review final fittings and operation with specialists
strings.بعد ما تكتمل مساحات كبيرة من التشطيب، تب: After large areas of finishing are complete, handles, light fittings, appliances and final components enter the project. Coordinate these carefully to avoid damaging completed work and verify that each item functions. Lesson fourteen in the Almusaileem series helps you organise an operational inspection with specialists and record completed items and follow-up work.
strings.تصميم توضيحي لمقارنة عينة لون مع دهان ال: Illustrative design to compare a color sample with wall paint under natural lighting
strings.تصميم توضيحي مولّد بالذكاء الاصطناعي، ول: AI-generated illustration, not a photograph of a completed Almusaileem project.
strings.قبل الجولة: شنو لازم يكون جاهز؟: Before the tour: What needs to be ready?
strings.راجع جدول المواد والموديلات، قائمة الأعم: Review the schedule of materials and models, the hidden work list, and the instructions for the composite products. Ask the project manager to specify the work that is ready for inspection, and is still under implementation. The installation of some parts and the operation of the systems may start before this stage depending on the project program; its presence here in the series is aimed at collecting its results before handover. Do not run a system that has not been confirmed by the specialist.
strings.جهّز قائمة غرفة بغرفة، وأمام كل بند اسم: Prepare a room-by-room checklist with a named specialist responsible for each item. Electrical, plumbing and air-conditioning work require their own specialist tests; decor and painting require finish inspections. If you supply an item but another party installs it, identify who checks suitability and provides its instructions so responsibility is not left unresolved between supplier and installer.
strings.اسأل عن طريق إدخال الأجهزة والأدوات، ومك: Ask by inserting the hardware and tools, the placement of the packaging, and the surface that needs protection during installation. See that the type of protection is suitable for the tent, and that lifting it leaves a mark. Do not ask to paste random protection materials on a recent paint or cladding; refer to the system instructions and the contractor view in the surface readiness. And state images before remaining work to make it easier to track any damage that appears afterwards.
strings.رتّب جولاتك بحيث ما تزاحم فرق العمل ولا: Plan inspections without obstructing work teams or removing protection unnecessarily. After appropriate cleaning, inspect junctions with walls and floors, installation residue and exposed edges. See
strings.تفاصيل التقاء الخامات والوزرات: Details of the meeting of materials and ministries
strings.يفيدك في اختيار نقاط المراجعة البصرية، م: It is useful for you to choose visual review points, with reference to the sample and detail approved in your project.
strings.اطلب شرح الاستخدام أمامك: Ask for an explanation of use in front of you
strings.خلّ كل مختص يشرح تشغيل الجزء اللي سلّمه: Each specialist explains the operation of the delivered part in the intended daily manner and shows the controls associated with it. You review the clarity of use and record the result, but technical tests, measurements, opening plates and connections are in his hand. The lighting or the exit of water alone is not a proof of the completion of the system tests; ask for the results of the relevant tests from the administrator.
strings.في الديكور، راجع فتح الأدراج والأبواب وح: In decoration, check the opening of drawers and doors and the movement of parts intended for use, and access to the service openings in the way explained by the contractor. With the screen wall, try the usual use of devices with its specialist and make sure the required access is clear. You can refer to
strings.ديكور الشاشة والتهوية والوصول للأجهزة: Screen Decor, Ventilation and Access Devices
To process questions regarding the design of the wall.
strings.سجّل النتيجة بدل كلمة «تم»: Record the result instead of the word "done"
strings.اكتب لكل بند المكان، الموديل، ما عُرض أم: Write down for each item the location, model, what is displayed in front of you, the result, and any facility provided by the specialist. An organizational example: «The drawer of the cabinet in the hall, the movement of opening and closing displayed, friction at the end needs to be reviewed». This is a description that can be followed without diagnosis from you. Leave a clear “did not check” case if an item requires readiness or someone else’s presence.
strings.دليل RIBA للتخطيط للاستخدام: RIBA Guide to Planning for Use
strings.مرحلة التسليم بتدريب المستخدم وتوفير دلي: The delivery stage is to train the user and provide a concept guide for the building. We take it as a principle to organize the explanation and information, not a local requirement. Ask the specialist the correct product guide, and record questions that remained unanswered before finishing his tour.
strings.قبل مغادرة كل غرفة، راجع مع المسؤول ما س: Before leaving each room, review with the administrator what will remain open and who will return to it. A short pause prevents the same question from being transmitted between more than one party without a specific answer.
strings.تحديد العناصر الجاهزة وأسماء المسؤولين ع: Identify ready items and the names of those responsible.
strings.حماية التشطيبات ومراجعة حالتها بعد الترك: Protect the finishes and review their condition after installation.
strings.عرض الاستخدام العادي بواسطة المختص المنا: Offer normal use by the appropriate specialist.
strings.جمع نتائج الفحوص الفنية المرتبطة بالمشرو: Collect the results of the technical tests associated with the project.
strings.تمييز الناجح وما يحتاج معالجة وما لم يُف: Distinguish the successful and what needs to be treated and what is not examined.
strings.استلام التعليمات وتسجيل الأسئلة والمواعي: Receive instructions and record questions and agreed dates.
strings.إذا عندك ملاحظات تخص أعمال الدهان أو الج: If you have notes for paint, plaster or cladding, send the pictures and the location of each note to
strings.لمناقشة نطاق العمل المطلوب. في الدرس الخ: to discuss the required scope. In lesson fifteen, we combine the findings into a clear handover checklist and follow each defect until it is checked again.
